faqs.q: Kya aap Tatkal railway tickets bhi book karte ho?
faqs.a: Haan, hum IRCTC ke through Tatkal aur general dono tarah ki railway ticket booking karte hain.

faqs.q: Screen repair mein kitna time lagta hai?
faqs.a: Zyada tar models ke liye humara Express Repair sirf 30 minute mein ho jata hai.

faqs.q: AEPS se ek din mein kitna paisa nikal sakte hain?
faqs.a: Withdrawal limit bank aur RBI guidelines ke hisaab se hoti hai — counter par current limit turant confirm kar denge.

faqs.q: Kya aap purane phone ka data recover karte ho?
faqs.a: Software issues aur kai hardware cases mein data recovery attempt karte hain — phone dikhane par exact estimate denge.
